CFB-week.summary: Five MAC midweek games (EMU at WMU and Ball State at Ohio on Tuesday; Miami (OH) at Kent State, Akron at UMass and Central Michigan at Buffalo on Wednesday). No current player-prop lines for any of them turned up after 10 searches: the prop and best-bet pages found were for the 2025 season or earlier weeks. No current injury or QB-change news was found either. The Nov 17 EMU-WMU matchup page lists Noah Kim and Broc Lowry as the returning passers but does not confirm either as the starter.

NBA-DET-at-SA-1118.summary: Detroit arrives thin on the wing: Duren, Holland, Prince and Robinson are out and Isaiah Joe is doubtful, so Huerter has been soaking up big bench minutes (nearly 38 on Nov 14). San Antonio gets De'Aaron Fox back from a hip issue (off the Nov 16 report after missing Sunday), which sends Champagnie back to the bench. Spurs are about 9-point favorites (opened 8.5), total about 223 (opened 220.5), so blowout risk trims Detroit starters' late minutes.

NBA-NY-at-TOR-1118.summary: This is a quick rematch in Toronto two days after the Nov 15 meeting. Scottie Barnes returned in that game from a left groin strain that cost him four games and posted a full stat line, so he looks fully back. New York lists nobody on its injury report; Toronto is still without Kawhi Leonard (knee) and Nate Bittle (foot). Knicks favored by about 3, total around 217.

SOCCER-day.summary: International window: most listed players are predicted starters with no injury news; Danilo Santos (Botafogo) is still sidelined with an adductor injury, and Jhon Arias faces a tight turnaround from Colombia duty. Scaloni plans changes for Argentina vs Costa Rica.

NBA-CHI-at-CLE-1117.summary: Cleveland gets Mitchell, Harden and Allen back after resting them Saturday, but Mobley (toe) and Merrill (elbow) are out and Watson and Tyson are questionable. Chicago is healthy outside Wilson and Awaka; Jalen Smith is questionable and Nic Claxton returns on a minutes limit.

NBA-GS-at-NO-1117.summary: Golden State plays its second game without Curry (oblique tear, possibly out up to a month) and Brandon Williams, with Melton starting in Curry's spot and Santos questionable. New Orleans is missing Murray, Murphy, Mathurin, Watford and McGowens, so Poole and Bey move into the starting lineup.

NBA-HOU-at-MIA-1117.summary: Houston is on the second night of a back-to-back after routing Washington; VanVleet sat that game as planned maintenance and is expected to start in Miami, and Steven Adams returned in a 12-minute stint. Miami's Pelle Larsson (illness) is questionable after missing two games, with Myron Gardner starting in his place. Houston is about -1.5, total 230.

NBA-MEM-at-WSH-1117.summary: Memphis is without Ty Jerome (hip, second straight game), GG Jackson and Pippen Jr., and all three centers (Edey, Stewart, Post) are questionable, so frontcourt minutes are unsettled; Jerami Grant is back off the injury report. Washington is on the second night of a back-to-back after a blowout loss to Houston, with Tre Johnson (back) ruled out Sunday and his Monday status not yet confirmed. Memphis is about a 4-point favorite, total 230.

NBA-ORL-at-BOS-1117.summary: Boston (11-2, six straight wins) lists no injuries; Orlando remains without Banchero (high-ankle sprain), Isaac, Penda and Nelson. Boston is roughly an 8.5-9.5 point favorite with a total near 212, so a lopsided game could trim starter minutes late.

NBA-PHI-at-BKN-1117.summary: Philadelphia (11-3) is on the second night of a back-to-back after beating Indiana without Embiid, who sat the first leg for right-foot plantar fascia management and is expected by pattern, not by announcement, to play in Brooklyn. LeBron James played Sunday and has not played both legs of a back-to-back this season; Bona, Barlow and Hukporti remain out, leaving the frontcourt thin.

NBA-PHX-at-DEN-1117.summary: No new injuries for either side's main players: Denver is missing only Julian Strawther (knee) and Phoenix only Mark Williams (shoulder). Denver returns home after finishing a 3-1 road trip Saturday; Phoenix has lost three straight on the road. Denver is a 10.5-point favorite (total 228.5), so a lopsided game could trim starters' fourth-quarter minutes.

NBA-POR-at-MIN-1117.summary: Minnesota (9-4) is without Edwards (knee scope), DiVincenzo (Achilles) and now Jaylen Clark (hamstring strain, re-evaluated in two weeks), leaving Ball and Dosunmu to carry the backcourt with Shannon Jr. and Hyland as fill-ins. Portland is without Morant, Sharpe and Krejci; Cissoko has started the last games in place of Scoot Henderson. Minnesota about -2, total 228.5.

NFL-LAC-at-BAL-1117.summary: Jacoby Brissett makes his Ravens debut with Lamar Jackson on IR (thumb) and Baltimore 4-5, held to 14 or fewer points in four straight games. The winless Chargers are without Ladd McConkey (back, out after missing practice all week), lost RG Branson Taylor, and Herbert was sacked eight times last week; Njoku and Perryman could return from IR.
